coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The old AI blog redirects to Microsoft Source AI. Homepage titles and original links were saved, but the View all list's latest date was May 19, inconsistent with October articles found through a separate tag feed. The configured feed returned HTTP 410. These gaps do not establish that there were no updates.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: Two /news links were extracted from the Tongyi Lab homepage, but their cards had no publication dates. Detail-page HTTP checks were recorded separately. Research links to qwen.ai/blog were not counted twice. The missing dates do not establish that there were no updates.
coverage_gaps.DeepSeek: The API update page, product pages, and GitHub were checked separately. The API page's latest date string was September 10; the news and Harness pages contained dates through September 29. Among the 20 most recently pushed repositories, deepseek-harness had pushes within the window, with 67 commits and the recorded releases. Other repositories' ordinary commits before the window boundary were not all read. Product pages lacked first-publication dates, and commits were not treated as announcements; the source remains partially checked.
coverage_gaps.智谱 Z.ai: Static HTML from the /news and /zh/news pages showed product descriptions but yielded no news links. The latest observed date and updatedAt value were September 10. Article URLs and publication dates from the news carousel were not extracted; missing dates do not establish that there was no news in the window.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: Static HTML contained a front-end shell without a dated news stream. Rendering showed navigation for Step 5 Preview, Step 3.7 Flash, and Step 3.5 Flash, but no absolute publication dates with a year. Relative labels and countdowns were not converted into dates.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: The homepage's latest announcement was dated September 24, before the discovery window. Active venues and open submissions were visible, but submissions were not filtered back to the window's starting boundary. Homepage access does not establish an absence of new submissions across venues.
coverage_gaps.MIT Technology Review AI（试用）: Rendering the topic page did not produce an article list. Its feed contained 10 entries, including two within the window; their full texts were not read.
coverage_gaps.404 Media（试用）: After loading more items, 25 news cards were saved, extending back to September 25 and crossing the window boundary. Dates were mostly day-level, and some AI investigations and the attribution of their evidence had not been read in full. The source remains partially checked.
